programme.desc: A Yu se le concede su deseo de ganar la Batalla de supervivencia. Él desea Battle Bladers, la batalla de bey más grande de todos los tiempos que determinará el blader número 1 del país. Doji llega y pronto se revela que todo esto ha sido parte de su complot: controlar Battle Bladers, para que Ryuga pueda derrotar a todos y Lightning L-Drago pueda absorber todo el poder de los oponentes.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Las batallas se están calentando en todas partes con los bladers ansiosos por ganar puntos para participar en la gran competencia Battle Bladers; Benkei, Kenta, Hikaru y Kyoya son especialmente exitosos acumulando más puntos. Mientras tanto, Gingka conoce a un nuevo rival, Tsubasa, quien le enseña algunos trucos del oficio.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Kyoya está frustrado porque sus oponentes no lo desafían. Él derriba a un oponente tras otro, incluidos grupos de ellos al mismo tiempo. Está aburrido hasta que conoce a Tobio ... también conocido como el Capitán Capri. El petulante Tobio calcula cada movimiento que parece errático, lo que lo convierte en una buena competencia contra el salvaje Kyoya.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Doji y Yu están buscando talentos para llevar a los Battle Bladers para que Ryuga pueda absorber su poder. Para su sorpresa, Tsubasa derrota a su espada en un torneo pero no pueden encontrar ninguna información sobre quién es este Tsubasa. Sorprendentemente, Tsubasa más tarde aparece en la sede de Dark Nebula con ganas de vender sus habilidades.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: La competencia para llegar a Battle Bladers se calienta cuando Blader DJ anuncia dos ubicaciones para torneos: una en el bosque y la otra junto al río. Kenta domina la competencia forestal mientras Hyoma lidera la etapa del río. Ambas batallas dan grandes vueltas cuando los no invitados espadachines Tsubasa y Yu rompen las fiestas.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Se trata de los últimos partidos desafiantes para Battle Bladers. Tetsuya Watagani está a la altura de sus viejos trucos eliminando oponentes con historias llorosas. Sus tácticas incluso funcionan contra Benkei, ya que finge ser su amigo y se aprovecha de él para ganar las semifinales. Ahora depende de Gingka y Tetsuya, pero Gingka no se dejará engañar.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: En medio de una lucha desafiante para Battle Bladers, Kenta se encuentra con un oponente luchador llamado Sora. Todos están impresionados con su increíble poder y agilidad ... hasta que pierde el control y finalmente pierde la batalla con Kenta. Más tarde, Kenta se pone al día con Sora, quien dice ser un aprendiz de Gingka, pero su historia es sospechosa.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Gingka, Benkei, Kenta y Madoka se enfrentan a un gran desafío de 10,000 puntos. Mientras esperan para competir, se encuentran con un adivino / espadachín, Ryutaro, quien dice ser fanático de Gingka. Gingka se sorprende cuando conoce a Ryutaro en su primer partido del torneo. Ryutaro se hace cargo del partido con "magia" y Gingka está en su ingenio para vencer a este oponente. Al final, Gingka descubre el plan de Ryutaro y él y Pegasus giran hacia la victoria.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: En un día emocionante de lucha, Blader DJ anuncia cuatro batallas en cuatro estadios diferentes a la vez. Mientras Kenta lucha por contener al dúo fraternal de Dan y Reiki, Benkei mira esa batalla, pierde el foco en su propia batalla y es derrotado por Tsubasa. Hyoma gana por poco contra Hikaru, mientras que Yu derriba a su oponente tan fácilmente que está molesto porque no tuvo una batalla más dura.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Solo quedan seis bladers en el último Beyblade Challenge Match. En un giro sorpresa, se les dice que la ronda final será un Battle Royal donde los seis competirán entre sí por los 10,000 Puntos Bey. En una temible final, las alianzas se forman y rompen y las tensiones aumentan, pero al final solo un Blader sigue girando para reclamar la victoria ... ¡Kyoya!

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Gingka un nuevo Digital Power Launcher que calcula su poder de lanzamiento mientras practica y también lleva sus puntos ganados en la batalla. Cuando Tetsuya se disfraza, los engaña para que le den el Bey Pointer de Gingka y trata de huir con él. Phoenix viene al rescate, pero luego desafía la voluntad de Gingka como espadachín, es decir, si realmente estuviera decidido a ganar, cuidaría mejor su puntero.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Después de haber perdido todos sus puntos en un partido anterior con Phoenix, Gingka está decidido a ganar cada partido hasta que llegue a Battle Bladers y finalmente pueda derrotar a Ryuga. En su primer combate, conoce a Teru, un blader que solía ser un bailarín talentoso hasta que estuvo involucrado en un accidente en el escenario.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Ryuga reaparece y comienza a competir y ganar varios partidos de desafío, ganando puntos a medida que avanza. Tsubasa está intrigado por el poder de L-Drago y se cuela en la sede de la Nebulosa Oscura para buscar datos sobre el 'bey prohibido'. Tsubasa aprende mucho, pero antes de que pueda escapar con la información, es atrapado por Doji y Yu y debe luchar contra un variedad de cuchillas Dark Nebula.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: En una acalorada batalla entre Tsubasa y Ryuga, Tsubasa está casi derrotado hasta que el misterioso Phoenix vuela y se hace cargo de la batalla, haciendo posible que Tsubasa escape. Más tarde, Gingka se enfrenta a Tobio (también conocido como Capitán Capri) en un estadio con paredes en movimiento. Mientras Doji y Yu observan, Capri usa sus habilidades de francotirador para aprovechar las paredes móviles.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Kenta llega a lo que parece ser un pueblo fantasma, pero se encuentra con algunos bladers que aún viven allí a pesar de que el estadio local ha sido tomado por una pandilla dirigida por Busujima. Kenta también se encuentra con su viejo amigo Sora, quien ha venido para luchar contra la pandilla y ganar el estadio para todos. Sora pierde mucho, pero con Kenta y la ayuda de la gente del pueblo, ¡lo intenta de nuevo y gana!

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: La pandilla celebra la calificación para los Battle Bladers cuando Gingka revela que no tiene suficientes puntos para lograrlo. Le ofrecen luchar contra él, pero él se niega, ya que no quiere poner en riesgo a sus amigos. Tsubasa llega y desafía a los bladers, pero Gingka tiene que despegar para hacer el último desafío. Mientras tanto, Hyoma, Hikaru y Benkei pierden puntos ante el feroz Tsubasa.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Phoenix lucha contra Tsubasa diciendo que si puede vencer a Phoenix, puede luchar contra Gingka. Phoenix supera a Tsubasa en una intensa batalla y luego desafía a Gingka. Cuando Gingka se encuentra contra la pared, Phoenix le recuerda el voto que hizo de que si pierde una batalla, dejará de ser beyblading para siempre.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: ¡Comienza Battle Bladers! Gingka y sus amigos llegan a la gran competencia de Battle Bladers, donde descubren que Doji está a cargo y los emparejamientos de batalla parecen un poco a su favor. No importa, Benkei derriba al Capitán Capri, Kenta vence a Tetsuya y en un impresionante combate final, Gingka elimina a Yu.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Kyoya y Tsubasa ganan sus combates iniciales en Battle Bladers, y luego es el turno de Hyoma. Se enfrenta a un espadachín desconocido, Reiji, un miembro de la Nebulosa Oscura. El bey de Reiji, Poison Serpent, no parece muy fuerte en sus ataques, pero Hyoma se da cuenta demasiado tarde de que cada vez que su bey Aries es golpeado, se le inyecta veneno que debilita sus defensas.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Los oponentes para la próxima ronda de Battle Bladers están listos, pero la pandilla está más preocupada por la salud de Hikaru, quien fue derrotado por Ryuga en las batallas iniciales. Ella está bien, y los bladers se dan cuenta de que deben concentrarse en ganar sus próximos partidos si quieren vengar su pérdida. Mientras tanto en Dark Nebula HQ, Yu se ve obligado a luchar contra Reiji para decidir si es digno de permanecer en la Organización.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: En la segunda ronda de Battle Bladers, Doji hace sus trucos habituales, cambiando las parejas de todos. Esto enfrenta a Benkei contra su ídolo Kyoya en una batalla desafiante que Kyoya gana a pesar de la increíble demostración de fuerza de Benkei. Gingka lucha contra el intenso Ryutaro, que tiene mucho en juego en esta batalla.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: La pandilla está alarmada por la forma en que la Nebulosa Oscura ha tratado a Yu, ya que está muy herido después de su batalla con Reiji. Kenta promete derrotar a Reiji por Yu y por todos los verdaderos espadachines. En su batalla con Reiji, Kenta engaña al oscuro nebulizador intercambiando su punta de rendimiento de Sagittario con la punta de la espada de Yu, Libra.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Tsubasa se prepara para su batalla más difícil, contra Ryuga y su bey Lightning L-Drago. Tsubasa tiene un plan para derrotar al Movimiento Oscuro de Ryuga y resulta efectivo ya que él y su bey Earth Eagle toman una ventaja temprana en su batalla. Sin embargo, la pelea termina con Ryuga triunfando y Tsubasa y Eagle ahora están fuera de Battle Bladers.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Las semifinales de Battle Bladers demuestran ser emocionantes con Gingka enfrentando a su oponente inductor de miedo, Reiji. Mientras tanto, Yu es llevado cautivo por Doji para cumplir con su deuda con la Nebulosa Oscura. Hyoma y Kenta ven a Doji llevándose a Yu y deciden no decirle a Gingka, ya que él está en un partido importante. Van a la Nebulosa Oscura para salvar a Yu, pero se encuentran con los secuaces de Doji.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: El intento de Kenta y Hyoma de rescatar a Yu parece haber fallado, hasta que Phoenix llega al cuartel general de Dark Nebula y entra en una terrible batalla contra Doji. En Battle Bladers, Gingka es empujado al límite cuando Reiji usa la Serpiente Venenosa para congelar a Gingka. Pero Gingka utiliza un enfoque de espejo en el que Pegasus refleja los ataques. Reiji se frustra cada vez más por la falta de miedo de Gingka hasta que Gingka finalmente toma el partido.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: Things get even more epic in Season 3 as Talking Tom and Friends try new ways to make their dreams come true, making more friends (and enemies) along the way!

programme.title: Monster Town
programme.desc: Miranda makes a cure to cheer up Mia, but she runs out of Happy Bird Eggs!

programme.title: Monster Town
programme.desc: Max and Mike argue about who is the strongest monster

programme.title: Monster Town
programme.desc: Miranda takes a drive through the forest and hears a humming noise coming from a rock on the side of the mountain, which suddenly pulls her towards it

programme.title: Monster Town

programme.title: Teen Wolf

programme.title: Teen Wolf

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the name of Tommy Hicks, who was executed for cowardice and desertion during World War I, is added to the war memorial in Midsomer Parva, the Hicks family are very glad. The son and grandson, Lionel and Mayor Dave Hicks, revel in the occasion. The Hammond family are much more displeased. Henry, the patriarch, is infuriated by the move, having sustained a long-running feud with the Hickses.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village of Dunstan, leads Barnaby and Jones to investigate the deaths of reclusive couple, Ron and Libby Wilson. Early on in the case, they learn that their son Michael had been killed in a hit and run. Not too far away a fiery dispute is in full swing, between a builder who has a very short fuse and a group of road protesters, protesting about plans for a bypass. With hostilities almost at breaking point, it is not long before another death rocks the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the body of Charlie Finleyson is found in woodland in Midsomer Sonning. Barnaby and Jones begin to scrutinise the employees at the offices of Midsomer Life magazine. It is discovered that Mr Finleyson was married to the ex-wife of Guy Sandys, the wealthy owner of the magazine. The detectives also become aware of a dispute between Guy and the owner of the Morecroft Hotel. With tensions starting to rise between the locals and visitors from London.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a children's magic show, a performer assisting with a trick, is poisoned whilst on stage. It is found that the poison came from a species of Ecuadorean frog. Barnaby and Jones discover that conflict is once again brewing between a village occult guide and enthusiast Ernest Baillol and famous writer Aloysius Wilmington who are both searching for a treasured antique book on the subject.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A team building exercise is imminent planned by a new acting Chief Superintendent John Cotton and Barnaby and Jones are very reluctant to take part. Following an explosion in a truck at a haulage yard, both the detectives see the opportunity as a distraction to investigate. It is not long after that a body is discovered, when a trunk resurfaces from the nearby lake. It is identified as Alec Grainger, a man who had been arguing with James Parkes, the son of Colonel Matt Parkes.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Monks Barton, two couples seemingly disappear from their cottages. When Barnaby and Jones arrive and learn of the legendary, mysterious haunted woods, they remain sceptical. Shortly after a body is found in a shallow grave, answering to the description of one of the 'missing'. The detectives have to delve much deeper into the woods and beyond to find out if ghosts are really to blame or something else.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Milton Cross depend on lord of the manor Edward Milton, for their jobs and income. When Sonia Woodley is found murdered in the churchyard, two years after the death of her abusive husband Gerald, the murder weapon is discovered to be tailor's shears, but which one of villagers is responsible? Barnaby and Jones arrive at Woodley and Woodley, the tailors to find out, to discover that the vicar had received a letter from Sonia a few days before.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a council meeting, Mayor Dave Hicks announces plans to awaken an annual trip to Brighton. Barnaby suspects his proposal to buy coastal land there is a fraud. Barnaby reluctantly joins the party, but during their time in Brighton, hated property developer Hugh Dalgleish is beheaded on a ghost train ride. The detectives together with Tom's cousin DCI John Barnaby gather who from the party or someone else could have been responsible before other murders occur and secrets are uncovered.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Ford Florey is anything but quiet, when the Wild West Society bring their show and fair, consisting of many stalls and a shooting re-enactment. The witch on the 'Dunk the Witch' stall, gets truly dunked and goes horribly wrong, when the water starts turning red. Barnaby and Jones have to be alert with a shooter in their midst. With many grudges, jealousies and a dispute over wasteland, known as 'the swamp', as possible motives, it is not long before more people turn up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: On a dark night in the village of March Magna, Joyce Barnaby swerves her car and narrowly misses a shadowy figure in the road. Shortly after a body is found in the local old cemetery. The victim Gerald Ebbs was a member of the council and of the village's library. It is discovered from the villagers that Gerald had had a strange fixation on both the old hospital and cemetery; in particular a grave from within.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Devington Manor Winter School led by internationally renowned musician Sir Michael Fielding, is a magnet for many aspiring piano students. Amongst the latest batch of students is Zoe Stock, a gifted young lady. Whilst in the grounds of the manor and by the riverbank, Zoe sees a woman jump from the bridge and disappear underwater. When Barnaby and Jones start their enquiries into the possible drowning, they discover many shady connections to the past.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When boxer John Kinsella wins a world title in New York, the village of Midsomer Morchard are overjoyed at his success. Shortly afterwards a solicitor is found dead by his assistant and Kinsella's manager. Barnaby and Jones start to investigate and come across infidelity, anger, betrayals and blackmail. When a Victorian prize-fight re-enactment turns nasty and Kinsella's manager is found murdered in his home's gym.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Midsomer Conservation Society are up in arms, when a recent new build, called Swanscombe House is a highlight of an open garden day. It leads to an ugly confrontation between a couple of its members and those responsible for the planning application, design and build. The people of which are suspected of involvement in a money-making scam. Political squabbles, burglaries and sexual liaisons all come to the fore in picturesque Great Pelfe.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A spa weekend at Swavely Manor, proves far from relaxing, when Tom and Joyce Barnaby arrive. programme.title: Bloomberg Wall Street Week
programme.desc: A weekly program telling the stories of capitalism from around the world, hosted by David Westin in New York.

programme.title: Bloomberg The Asia Trade
programme.desc: Bloomberg The Asia Trade: Bringing global investors everything you need to know as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Asia with Haidi Stroud-Watts, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping markets — from tech, to geopolitics, and the world’s energy transition.

programme.title: Bloomberg: The China Show
programme.desc: "Bloomberg: The China Show" is your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter.

programme.title: Insight with Haslinda Amin
programme.desc: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day. With news making executives, officials and thought-leaders from the world of business, politics and academia we will explore a story through probing interviews and nuanced conversations. The hour of programming will also highlight the most relevant stories from India which is currently one of the hottest investment destinations, but also has compelling stories that play into the Bloomberg's priority issues such as Climate change, Diversity and Technological innovation.

programme.title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa
programme.desc: A spotlight on the fast paced growth and major deals happening across the Middle East and Africa. Linking the market drivers from overnight in the US and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep dive analysis of the top business, energy and geopolitical stories shaping the decisions of traders across the Middle East, Africa and beyond.

programme.title: Bloomberg Daybreak Europe
programme.desc: Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. Live from London, we set the agenda for your day, catching you up with overnight markets news from the US and Asia. And we'll tell you what matters for investors in Europe, giving you insight before trading begins.

programme.title: Bloomberg The Opening Trade
programme.desc: The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game.

programme.title: The Pulse with Francine Lacqua
programme.desc: The Pulse with Francine Lacqua is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics. Based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

programme.title: Bloomberg Brief
programme.desc: Bloomberg Brief delivers the market news, data and analysis you need to set your agenda.

programme.title: Bloomberg Surveillance
programme.desc: Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern have the economy and global markets "under surveillance". Their daily conversations with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond cover the latest in business, investment, and geopolitics. No other program better positions investors and executives for the trading day.

programme.title: Bloomberg Open Interest
programme.desc: Bloomberg Open Interest with Matt Miller and Dani Burger — delivers the market-moving news you need to know to get a jump start on the US trading day.

programme.title: Bloomberg Tech
programme.desc: Bloomberg Tech is the only daily live technology program with a focus on breaking news, market-moving reporting and analysis of global technology companies and stories. The program brings the audience interviews from the biggest names in the business, offering in-depth analysis and critical insights.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Paul was his family’s rock and role model, so when he suddenly passed away, his wife and four children say their lives were shattered. Debbie, who was married to Paul for 30 years, says she shut down after his death and doesn’t know how to unite her brood. Sisters Jamie, Erica and Tayler say they don’t know how to properly grieve, they’re always fighting with each other, and they’re upset that their brother, Paul, turned his back on them. Paul says he didn’t run away from his loved ones; he has his own family and says he feels stretched thin. Find out the secret Erica’s been keeping that threatens to throw everyone into further turmoil, and hear the final wish Jamie’s dad had for her. If you’re grappling with grief after the loss of a relative, learn how to find closure and peace.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you're a parent having an extramarital affair " whether it's physical or emotional " should you tell your children? Or, if you're thinking about getting a divorce, how much should the kids know and when should they know it? Dr. Phil meets with a family torn apart over one parent's desire for a divorce.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Families fight – that’s a fact of life. For most, tempers flare, you make up and life goes on. For sisters Maggie and Marsha however, they haven’t spoken in two years, and the rift has their family trapped in the middle. See their emotional reunion as another sister caught in the crossfire brings the matter before Dr. Phil. Also on the show...they seem like the all-American family, but these two sisters feel their once solid family bond is a distant memory. Join one of them as she confesses to her parents her true feelings, and hear how she suppressed a devastating secret for years. Tune in as Dr. Phil gives them the tools to bridge their emotional divide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you know people that can’t mind their own business? Dr. Phil’s first guest is fed up with her mother-in-law’s constant meddling in financial affairs, parenting, and even their intimate relations! So why does her husband frequently side with his parents? The friction mounts when members of this blended family speak out! Then, meet a 23-year-old woman who says her grandmother is smothering her. Can Dr. Phil help this dueling duo redefine their boundaries? Plus, find out how to deal with annoying backseat drivers before they drive you insane!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Everyone knows people that love to bicker. But what happens when the bickering escalates into verbal abuse and violence? Dr. Phil checks in with past guests Troy and Tammy whose explosive arguing is the primary dynamic in their marriage. Have they been able to break the cycle of drama or are they one step closer to divorce? Then—meet a single mother of five who worries that her children’s bickering may lead to fatal consequences! She thinks they’re out of control. So why is her daughter pointing the finger at her? Dr. Phil helps her end the fighting once and for all.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil revisits some of the most high-profile custody battles fought in the public eye. Model Bridget Marks is in the fight of her life after a court ordered her to turn her 4-year-old twin girls over to their father. Now, Dr. Phil gets her side of the story and what she plans to do next. And, when a mother decides she wants to move to Alaska with her kids, her ex-husband decides he’s going to fight her to the bitter end. Plus, a 12-year-old boy is caught between the grandmother who raised him and a mother desperate to reclaim him. Dr. Phil addresses the real casualties of these wars - the children - and talks about rules to live by when custody battles arise.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Where there’s a will, there’s a war! Jay says he was betrayed and ripped off by his sister Carole. She says her brother owes her money from their father's estate. She wants him to pay up. But is their family feud really about the money? After more than three years without speaking to each other, the gloves come off! Then, Christy borrowed $100,000 from her mother but refuses to pay the money back until her mother kicks out the convicted sex offender she’s been living with.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil shares advice for dealing with rude, crude and obnoxious behavior from your family members.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every household has a relative who stirs the pot and creates conflict and havoc for the rest of the family. These troublemakers too often make holidays and family gatherings a living hell!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On Thanksgiving Day 2013, the Hutson family’s celebration turned deadly when 19-year-old Rachel fatally shot her mother while her father was out shopping – and then texted her father a photo of her mother’s body. Rachel's lawyers say she had a history of mental illness that had gone undiagnosed for years. Did the added stress of caring for her ailing mother push her to snap? Or did she have a different motive? In an exclusive interview, will what caused her to commit this unthinkable crime finally be revealed? And, Rachel comes face-to-face with her family for the first time since she was sentenced.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jacob’s son Blake was burned at 2 1/2 years old on a treadmill in his sister Ellen’s home at Thanksgiving in 2014. Jacob claims Ellen was 100% responsible for his son’s injuries and scars. Jacob’s wife, Beth, says that their family was uninvited to further Thanksgivings by Ellen. Ellen says that she never uninvited Jacob and his family, is not responsible for Blake’s injuries and says that in the four-and-a-half years Jacob has held this grudge, Blake hasn’t developed scars. Ellen and Jacob’s brother, Ed, says that he’s tried to play mediator, but after Jacob went on a social media rant in February 2019, rehashing the accident and continuing to blame Ellen, he knew that this unhealthy family feud needed bigger help. Can Dr. Phil help these siblings mend fences? Also- Pfizer’s Chief Patient Officer, Dr. Freda Lewis-Hall, discusses what Americans need to know about rheumatoid arthritis.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mothers and their teenage daughters are rife for conflict under normal circumstances, but what happens when one party turns violent? Victoria wrote to Dr. Phil after she says her 18-year-old daughter, Jessica, physically attacked her on multiple occasions, leaving a gash in her head from a cellphone and her house damaged, as well as her body bruised after a Thanksgiving day family throw down. Victoria says she’s tried everything she can to help Jessica and she’s afraid her daughter is going to end up homeless, in jail, or dead without Dr. Phil’s help.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A desperate search for a missing 2-year-old boy in Texas, and a horrifying new discovery. Baby James’ family say they haven’t seen the toddler since Thanksgiving and claim his mother gave them a string of weak excuses when they asked where he was. In an exclusive interview, James’ great aunt says she feared something terrible had happened to the baby. She made a secret recording of her niece, the child’s mother, D’Lanny Chairez, who insisted that she placed her son for adoption. But James' great aunt says she wasn’t buying it, and when she went into D’Lanny’s home to search for James, she says what she found horrified her -- a terrible smell and a bloody blanket that police believe came from the baby’s crib. Was D’Lanny telling the truth about her son’s whereabouts? Don’t miss the shocking update.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Six months ago, Ed revealed to his wife of 12 years that he'd been having an affair. That news was shocking enough, but shortly after he dropped another bombshell: The mistress is pregnant.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After 12 years of marriage, Ed revealed to Kandi that he'd been having an affair and his mistress is now pregnant. Dr. Phil continues his in-depth look at the anatomy of an affair.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shannon, 24, says two years ago, her ex-boyfriend stabbed her multiple times, and she feels betrayed by her mother, Dian, because she didn’t visit her in the hospital. Can they make peace with the past and fix their relationship? Plus, Kasey says she wants her 24-year-old son to stop living at home and playing video games all the time -- but is she part of the problem?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you think about everything you eat with the fear of gaining weight? Do you skip meals to lose weight? What about your teenager? Dr. Phil takes an eye-opening journey into the mind of an anorexic and bulimic. Meagan is 26 and weighs only 73 pounds. She starves herself all day, abuses laxatives, and binges and purges at night when everyone is asleep. She's been battling her eating disorders for over 10 years. Her parents, Donna and Tom, fear she could die at any moment and admit they enable Meagan’s disease to keep the peace. Meagan’s sister, Erika, says she’s so disgusted with her sister, she can’t stand being in the same room with her. When one member of the family has an eating disorder, it can make the entire family dysfunctional. Will Meagan accept help, and will her family do the work necessary to support her? Do you know the warning signs of someone who is at risk of developing an eating disorder? Parents, you can’t afford to miss this show!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his discussion with Meagan and her family. Meagan is a 26-year-old anorexic and bulimic who weighs only 73 pounds. She rules her house with her eating disorders, and her family is saying enough is enough. Will she give up control and accept help before it’s too late? And, get an update on Jennifer’s family. Three months ago, they sought Dr. Phil’s help for their daughter, who was battling anorexia and bulimia. How is Jennifer doing now? Her parents, Sue and Allan, and sister, Abbey, share with Meagan’s family what they’ve learned while Jennifer has been in treatment and how they can take their lives back and stop enabling the disease. Plus, test your knowledge of eating disorders. Would you recognize the warning signs?

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with The Dr. Phil Family. Gene and Myra’s marriage has become a war zone, with ugly fights involving name-calling, spitting and throwing objects. Their children were caught in the middle and wrote to Dr. Phil for a family intervention. To find out if their broken marriage has a chance and to heal the resentment between all the family members, they move into The Dr. Phil House. First, Dr. Phil arranges for Myra to meet Lee, a pregnant self-proclaimed mistress in a long-term relationship with a married man. Will hearing another perspective help Myra let go of her anger and bitterness over Gene’s adulterous past? Next, since Gene admits he treats women like sexual objects, Dr. Phil wants to set him straight. Three successful women arrive at the house, determined to change Gene’s views about the opposite sex. After listening to them speak, Gene breaks down and says he wants to become a better husband. But do the ladies think he’s sincere? Gene and Myra’s three adult children, Melissa, Edwin and Eugene, join them in the house. After trying to have secret conversations off camera, Melissa gets a wake-up call when Dr. Phil knocks on the door. Then, in an exercise designed to get to the root of their resentments for each other, each family member takes a turn in the “hot seat” while the others open up about what they hate about them. Guess which person can’t take the criticism and wants to leave?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with The Dr. Phil Family, an out-of-control, angry group with a long history of infidelities, betrayals and bitter resentments. Melissa’s boyfriend, Randy, joins the family at The Dr. Phil House, but Gene and Myra are not happy to see him. They think that Randy is a liar and a thief, and the reason Melissa has gained about 100 pounds in the last five years. Gene and Myra attempt to talk to Melissa about her weight, but Melissa is anything but receptive. Then, because they often blame each other for the chaos in the family, Melissa and Gene are assigned to bury the hatchet long enough to cook a family dinner together, without help from anyone else. Will these relatives be able to follow the rules? After dinner, a family meeting turns heated with accusations and tearful confessions. Dr. Phil joins the family and confronts Melissa and Randy about their sometimes violent relationship and Melissa’s mismanagement of her health. Can this couple create a nurturing relationship for the sake of their autistic child? Will Melissa do what it takes to gain control over her weight?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After all their hard work, the latest Dr. Phil Family receives some surprises from Dr. Phil! He informs Melissa that everything she needs to get her life back on track is headed her way: a complete health evaluation, personal trainer, nutritionist, and food service delivered to her door. In addition, she’ll receive help for her depression and be connected with a developmental disabilities specialist for her autistic son. But it all comes with a condition: Melissa and Randy need to heal their toxic relationship. Then, a talk with Myra and Gene leads to a tearful apology. And, will a one-on-one with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin, help Myra see that she deserves to be treated with dignity and respect? Will Myra set some standards in her broken marriage? Will there even be a marriage to speak of when they get home? Dr. Phil has some strong words for Gene. Next, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity pits brother against brother as Edwin and Eugene audition for a Hollywood talent agent and a casting director. Don’t miss the surprising twist when they get a call from the judges. Then, it’s time to switch gears – literally! Since Myra and Melissa never learned to drive, Dr. Phil sets them up with a driving lesson so they can become more independent. And you won’t believe the prize in store for the women if they pass their driver’s test! Dr. Phil sits down with the entire family one last time. Will they use the tools he gave them to build healthier relationships?

With time flying and stress mounting the team works long hours and weekends trying to finish this iconic build. With SEMA only days away, the A100 finally gets it’s iconic 426 HEMI engine, well, if they can make it fit!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

With the A100 finished the team heads out to SEMA in order to roll the Little Dead Wagon over the red carpet for Mopar and Mark once again receives a very kind gift from our friends.

programme.title: Operation Christmas List
programme.desc: 12-year-old Barney has a plan to ensure he gets that bike he wanted for Christmas. To do this he needs to get his hands on the hottest toy in town, a Crabby Mousie Doll. But plans change when he has to save his favourite toy store from a big box CEO.

programme.title: A Horse Called Hope
programme.desc: A strong-willed but moody teenager Lizzy is sent to live on her grandmother’s ranch after an incident at school gets her suspended. Although reticent at first, Lizzy finally starts to unwind with the help of a nameless pony whom she calls Hope. When Lizzy learns the unfortunate news that the ranch is about to be foreclosed; she devises a plan that will not only save her grandmother’s property but also help Hope in the process.

programme.title: A Very English Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas in the English countryside wasn't in Emma's plans until her sister, Amy, plans her wedding for Christmas eve. Dylan, Amy's co-Christmas market owner, teams up with Emma to bring order to the whirlwind wedding.

programme.title: Christmas Roses
programme.desc: A young girl struggling with grief and a lonely woman who has shut herself off from the world find their lives unexpectedly intertwined. As the magic of Christmas weaves through their hearts, they discover that love, forgiveness, and second chances are the greatest gifts of all.

programme.title: Destined At Christmas
programme.desc: Two people meet on Black Friday, get separated, and yearn to reunite—if only they knew each other’s last names and numbers. Can destiny help them find each other by Christmas?

programme.title: Christmas Harmony
programme.desc: A successful songwriter returns to her small hometown to rediscover music, family bonds and the magic of the Christmas season.

programme.title: Christmas On 5th Avenue
programme.desc: Hopeless romantic Eva Jordan loves everything about Christmas. She even owns her own Christmas concierge in New York City, making the season special for all her fund and eccentric clients. This year as she decorates a spectacular Manhattan Penthouse for Christmas, bubbly Eva Jordan brings moody writer Lucas Blade some joy for the holidays.

programme.title: Miracle Maker: A Christmas Tale
programme.desc: “The Miracle Maker is coming!” If any town is in need of a miracle, it’s Woodhaven, a tiny town hanging on the edge of the American frontier. It’s nearly Christmas, but it’s hardly a season of celebration. Work is scarce, money is tight, love is lagging, and spirits are down. Maybe the Miracle Maker can turn things around. The town anxiously waits for someone magnificent who can change their lives. But the ragged traveler who appears isn’t what anyone expects—except for one small silent boy and a precocious little girl. It seems this man can barely take care of himself, let alone fulfill the dreams of others. But miracles can come in all shapes and sizes—and sometimes from unexpected places. Your entire family will love this Christmas tale of hope, love, and miracles.

programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.desc: A boy raised by his servant vows to take revenge on the ranchers who killed his parents.

programme.desc: A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

programme.desc: Former partner Milt Brower (William Farnum) and Pa Jackson (Stanley Andrews) are engaged in an embittered land dispute that turns ugly when Jackson accuses Brower of the dastardly crime of cattle rustling.

programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) clears the outlaw (Donald Barry) and his gang of a bank robbery done by bankers.

programme.desc: Rex (Rex Allen) and Slim (Slim Pickens) journey to Colorado, where Slim is expecting to claim the estate of the departed Zeke Reynolds, but the will also includes Jacqueline Reynolds and the evil Hurley siblings, and a fight ensues.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: A Texas Ranger pretends he has been discharged from service to trick outlaws into accepting him into their gang.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief.

programme.title: Enemy of the Law
programme.desc: Former Texas Ranger Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), now an attorney, is called back into law enforcement by his old pals Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and Panhandle Perkins (Guy Wilkerson), who want his help recovering some stolen gold.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A Denver widow (Conchata Ferrell) with a daughter becomes a Scottish rancher's (Rip Torn) housekeeper in 1910 Wyoming.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: A gunsmith (Lane Chandler) offers to fix outlaws' guns if they release their hostage to him.

programme.title: Six-Gun Trail
programme.desc: Posing as an Asian, a Washington agent goes after a gem-smuggling outlaw gang.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: The Lone Rider (Bob Livingston) and his sidekick (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) crunch an Arizona grazing-land monopoly.

programme.title: Raiders of Old California
programme.desc: After the war with Mexico, cavalry officers try to steal land from Mexican peasants to establish their own empire.

programme.title: Fighting Westerner
programme.desc: Heirs of a radium mine owner face murder attempts. A mining engineer investigates to find the killer and prove his cousin's innocence. The mine's value motivates the crimes.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When a young man discovers gold, he must deal with threats.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
programme.desc: Outlaw lumbermen frame a singing cowboy (Gene Autry) ; his friend (Jimmy Lloyd) saves him with a plane.

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: A cowboy (Bob Steele) framed for murder breaks out of jail to prove his innocence.

programme.title: The Two-Gun Man
programme.desc: A cowboy (Ken Maynard) rousts rustlers and woos a blonde (Lucille Powers) on the range.

programme.title: Young Bill Hickok
programme.desc: The frontier hero (Roy Rogers) sings and saves Civil War gold with his sidekick (George "Gabby" Hayes).

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: A spate of road accidents puts pressure on the emergency team. programme.desc: Dr Mark Putland assembles a crack team to save a man with a gunshot wound to the neck with a rare procedure to keep him breathing. programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Nurse Yasna Cardoza’s patient slipped in the shower and his wounds are very deep – but the thought of an operation terrifies him. programme.desc: Split-second events throw lives into chaos. Dr Jonathan Papson’s trauma patient wasn’t wearing a seatbelt when her car rolled, but she’s more worried about what her dad will say. programme.title: Emergency

programme.title: Paramedics

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Reddington et Liz sont sur la liste des dix fugitifs les plus recherchés par le FBI. Liz a abattu le Procureur Général Connolly, qui était lié à la Cabale et elle est de plus soupçonnée d’être responsable de la mort de 14 agents de la CIA dans un attentat. Reddington va tout mettre en œuvre pour leur faire quitter Washington afin d’échapper à leurs poursuivants. Il a activé un contact connu sous le nom de « Désinformateur », spécialiste dans la création de leurres et de fausses pistes pour égarer les forces de police. Parallèlement, Dembe est attiré dans un piège par un certain M. Salomon, membre de la Cabale, qui a l’intention de se servir de lui pour remonter jusqu’à Reddington. Ressler, qui a maintenant pris les commandes de l’unité spéciale est contacté par Tom qui lui propose ses services pour tenter de disculper Elizabeth. Bien que Ressler ne soit absolument pas convaincu de la culpabilité de son ex coéquipière il va refuser l’offre de Tom Keen. Durant leur exfiltration, dans deux véhicules séparés Reddington arrive à se faufiler entre les mailles du filet alors que Liz reste bloquée à l’intérieur du périmètre de recherche établi par le FBI. Elle n’a d’autre choix que de chercher refuge à l’ambassade de Russie où elle se présente comme agent du FSB.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz s'est réfugiée dans l'ambassade de Russie. Elle prétend être un agent du FSB en mission d'infiltration. Elle demande l'asile diplomatique. La Cabale fait jouer ses relations pour obtenir son transfert au Kremlin, l'idée étant de la liquider dès qu'elle sera à bord de l'avion. Reddington fait pression sur l'ambassadeur de Russie pour savoir ce qui se passe et informe immédiatement Ressler de la situation. Ce dernier attaque le convoi et sauve Liz qui s'enfuit. Elle retrouve Reddington dans un café, très vite cerné par la police. Reddington prend alors en otage tous les clients et lance un ultimatum au FBI. Il exige, entre autre, qu'on amène Marvin Gerard, un avocat incarcéré. Il compte sur celui-ci pour l'aider. Au final, la prise d'otage n'était qu'un prétexte pour faire s'évader l'avocat qui croit avoir trouvé le moyen de s'attaquer à la Cabale grâce au Fulcrum. Liz et Reddington s'enfuient à bord d'un navire-cargo. Tom se présente devant Ressler : il veut aider Liz.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Reddington pense que le seul moyen de disculper Liz est de forcer la Cabale à lâcher le Directeur et de révéler ce qui s'est vraiment passé. Pour ce faire il va s'attaquer à la firme d'agro-industrie Verdient qui a partie liée avec la Cabale. Mais Reddington et Liz vous découvrir une opération destinée à répandre un virus dans les cultures céréalières OGM au niveau mondial. On découvrira que cette opération est en fait montée par Verdiant afin de faire monter les tarifs de nouvelles semences immunisées contre le virus. Ressler et Samar sont toujours à la poursuite des deux fugitifs et remontent eux aussi la piste de Verdiant. Tom de son côté se rend chaque jour dans un restaurant où Liz doit l'appeler en cas de danger. Mais à sa grande surprise il voit arriver Cooper qui lui propose un marché. Dembe quant à lui est toujours aux mains de M. Salomon qui tente de lui extorquer des informations au sujet de Reddington.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Reddington et Liz sont à la recherche du Djinn, une femme qui permet à ses clients de réaliser leur vœu le plus funeste, souvent un désir de vengeance. Ils demandent de l'aide à Aram qui est forcé de s'en expliquer à Ressler. L'équipe découvre assez vite que le Djinn cherche à provoquer la faillite d'un homme, Bahram Bakhash. Il s'avère que le Djinn est sa fille, Nasim, qui était, en fait, son fils avant que son père ne découvre qu'il était gay et ne le force à changer de sexe. Elle se servait d'Alice, une ancienne hôtesse d'accueil, pour tenir le rôle du Djinn auprès de ses clients. Red contraint Nasim à lui donner le registre où sont notés tous les noms de ses clients parmi lesquels figurent deux membres influents de la Cabale. Avec Liz, ils réussissent à échapper à Ressler et Samar, au dernier moment, mais ils leur livrent Nasim. Pendant ce temps, Dembe s'enfuit avec l'aide de M. Vargas, mais celui-ci lui tire dessus et contacte M. Solomon pour lui révéler comment localiser Reddington.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Nous retrouvons Tom qui cherche à entrer dans le cercle des amis du jeune milliardaire Asher Sutton en se faisant passer pour un arnaqueur débrouillard. Il parvient à se faire inviter aux fiançailles d'Asher et Gwen. Durant la fête un homme de main vient réclamer de l'argent à Ashton. Tom intervient et plus tard, ira jusqu'à abattre l'homme de main dans l'unique but de se faire rechercher par le gang qui protège Karakurt, le terroriste qui a fait accuser à tort Elizabeth Keen. Reddington découvre qu'un tueur à gage, dont on ne connaît que le pseudonyme, Wendigo, est sur les traces de Liz. Reddington prévient Ressler pour qu'ils puissent tous deux protéger la jeune femme. Ils vont découvrir l'existence d'un site Internet recrutant des tueurs à gages payés par une plateforme de financement participatif. Ressler de son côté doit en parallèle témoigner devant la commission d'enquête présidentielle où il sera confronté au Directeur de la CIA. Ils devront finalement accepter de travailler en collaboration, à la demande de Laurel Hitchin, la présidente de la commission. Toujours à la recherche de Dembe, Reddington retrouve Vargas qui va l'entraîner dans un piège tendu par Matias Solomon. Mais Reddington et Liz sont sauvés in extremis par Dembe. Profitant de la situation Reddington crée la mise en scène du début de l'épisode pour faire croire à la mort de l'agent Keen.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red veut mettre la main sur Andras Halmi, un fidèle conseiller du Directeur, qui doit lui permettre d’aider à innocenter Liz. Mais celui-ci a disparu, tout comme d’autres experts, un homme et une femme à chaque fois, les meilleurs spécialistes dans leur domaine. Red demande de l’aide à Ressler et le charge de retrouver Halmi sans alerter le Directeur. Il s’avère qu’un milliardaire, Sir Crispin Crandall, est à l’origine de ces enlèvements : il désire « sauver » ces hommes et femmes en les cryogénisant. Red et Liz réussissent à localiser le corps d’Halmi, embarqué dans l’avion du milliardaire, avant l’arrivée de M. Solomon, prévenu par le Directeur qui a fait espionner Ressler au sein du FBI. Ils utilisent ses pouces pour accéder à l’argent mis de côté par le Directeur pour préparer une éventuelle fuite. Red tente de faire pression sur lui pour qu’il innocente Keen. Il refuse. Pendant ce temps, Tom réussit enfin à remonter jusqu’à Karakurt.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Iran, 1992. Nous découvrons les circonstances du décès des parents de Samar. Elle jure alors à son jeune frère d'être toujours là pour le protéger. Après ce flash-back nous retrouvons Tom qui vient déposer Karakurt chez Cooper afin de l'interroger. Reddington, après avoir sollicité un rendez-vous auprès d'un mystérieux correspondant promet en contrepartie de livrer à celui qui doit organiser la rencontre un terroriste nommé Zal Ben Hasaan. Pendant ce temps les membres de l'unité spéciale apprennent l'enlèvement de 6 techniciens travaillant pour Lazarum System, qui fournit des éléments de sécurité à Israël par un groupe terroriste, mené par Zal Ben Hasaan. Le FBI va demander au Mossad de collaborer pour libérer les otages. Mais en fait la prise d'otage n'est qu'un écran de fumée pour permettre aux terroristes de s'introduire dans les locaux du Mossad en Virginie et y dérober la liste des agents travaillant sur l'identification des groupes terroristes. Durant la libération des otages, Samar retrouve son jeune frère, Shahin, qu'elle croyait mort quelques années plus tôt. Elle découvrira qu'il n'est autre que le fameux Zal Ben Hasaan et n'hésitera pas à le livrer à Reddington

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Reddington et Liz sont en route pour rejoindre Dembe qui doit prendre livraison d'un paquet essentiel pour faire innocenter Liz. Mais Reddington disparaît : il s'est fait enlever par un gang, les Kings of the Highway, qui compte monnayer sa liberté. Liz fait appel à Samar, qui se trouve au lit chez Ressler, pour localiser Red. Ressler se doute de quelque chose quand il voit qu'une recherche a été faite sur son ordinateur portable personnel. Il finit par tout découvrir. Il renvoie Samar et vient enquêter dans le coin où se trouvent Reddington et Liz. Pendant ce temps, le gang a découvert la vraie identité de leur prisonnier et de la femme qui l'accompagnait. Liz remonte leur piste grâce à un de leur complice et accepte de leur donner le paquet pour faire libérer Reddington. Au moment de l'échange, Ressler et la police arrivent. Il capture Liz. Reddington réussit à s'enfuir. Pendant ce temps, Tom et Cooper tentent d'échapper à Solomon en extrayant la puce insérée sous la peau de Karakurt. Et Laurel Hitchin tue Reven Wright parce qu'elle avait trouvé un lien entre elle et Solomon.
